reasons: 類似カード（Chandra 等）には盤面を作る能力がなく、モデルが強さを低く見積もりました。
盤面が膠着しやすい環境で、プレインズウォーカーが攻撃から守られて長く残り、能力を使い続けられたと考えられます。
reasons_en: The similar cards (e.g. Chandra) have no way to build a board, so the model likely underrated this card.
In a stalled-board environment, planeswalkers were protected from attacks, stayed on the battlefield longer and kept using their abilities (estimate).

reasons: リミテッドでは手札破壊は弱いという過去データの傾向にモデルが引っ張られました。
長期戦で相手が手札にボムや除去を温存しやすい環境だったため、手札を一度に捨てさせる効果の価値が高くなったと考えられます。
reasons_en: The model was likely pulled by the historical pattern that discard is weak in Limited.
In a slow, long-game environment where opponents hold back bombs and removal, making them discard cards all at once became more valuable (estimate).

reasons: 類似カード（Lord Xander など）は効果の再現性が低く、この「墓地の質に応じた大きなリターン」をモデルが評価しきれませんでした。
遅い環境で、カード差を積み上げる青黒のデッキが勝ちやすかったと考えられます。
reasons_en: The similar cards (e.g. Lord Xander) are less reliable, so the model could not fully value this "big return depending on the graveyard".
In a slow environment, blue-black decks that stack up card advantage likely won more often (estimate).

reasons: 盤面が膠着しやすい環境で、プレインズウォーカーが攻撃から守られて長く残り、能力を使い続けられたと考えられます。
reasons_en: In a stalled-board environment, planeswalkers were protected from attacks, stayed on the battlefield longer and kept using their abilities (estimate).

reasons: 青のコントロール寄りのデッキが環境で機能し、重いインスタントが腐りにくかったと考えられます。
長期戦になりやすく、重いカードを唱えるまでの時間を確保できたと考えられます。
reasons_en: Blue control-leaning decks worked in this environment, and a heavy instant was less likely to be stuck in hand (estimate).
Games tended to go long, so players had time to reach the mana for heavy cards (estimate).

reasons: 5色すべてのマナを出せるため、この環境の多色・混成カードやタッチを支える役割が大きかったと考えられます。
どのデッキにも入るため使用数も多く（約40,000件）、汎用性の価値をモデルが過小評価しました。
reasons_en: It makes all five colors of mana, so it likely played a large role in supporting multicolor and hybrid cards and splashes in this environment (estimate).
It goes in nearly any deck, so it was played a lot (about 40,000 samples), and the model underrated the value of that versatility.

reasons: この環境は想定より遅く長期戦になりやすかったため、時間をかけて価値を生むカードが強く出たと考えられます。
reasons_en: The environment was slower and longer than expected, so cards that generate value over time likely performed strongly (estimate).

reasons: ジェイス関連カードとの組み合わせで、長期戦に強くなったと考えられます。
reasons_en: Combined with Jace-related cards, it likely got stronger in long games (estimate).

reasons: 類似カード（Poet's Quill など）よりも除去性能が高く、モデルはこの「除去としての価値」を低く見積もりました。
reasons_en: It has stronger removal than similar cards (e.g. Poet's Quill), and the model underrated its value as removal.

reasons: 白青の占術・諜報テーマが実際に機能したことが上振れの主因と考えられます。
遅い環境で、カード差を積み上げる白青のデッキが勝ちやすかったと考えられます。
reasons_en: The white-blue scry/surveil theme actually worked, which is thought to be the main reason for the upside (estimate).
In a slow environment, white-blue decks that stack up card advantage likely won more often (estimate).

reasons: 青黒の墓地を貯めるデッキでは、追加の1枚として働いたと考えられます。
遅い環境で、カード差を積み上げる青黒のデッキが勝ちやすかったと考えられます。
reasons_en: In blue-black decks that fill the graveyard, it likely worked as an extra card (estimate).
In a slow environment, blue-black decks that stack up card advantage likely won more often (estimate).

reasons: 盤面が膠着しやすい環境で、プレインズウォーカーが攻撃から守られて長く残り、能力を使い続けられたと考えられます。
reasons_en: In a stalled-board environment, planeswalkers were protected from attacks, stayed on the battlefield longer and kept using their abilities (estimate).

reasons: 青の軽量アドバンテージ源として安定して働いたと考えられます（件数は約40,000件）。
reasons_en: It likely worked steadily as a cheap blue card-advantage source (about 40,000 samples) (estimate).

reasons: 青黒の墓地を貯めるデッキでは再利用時にトークンが大きくなり、類似カードよりも後半の価値が高くなりました。
遅い環境で、カード差を積み上げる青黒のデッキが勝ちやすかったと考えられます。
reasons_en: In blue-black graveyard decks the tokens grow when recast, so its late-game value was higher than the similar cards.
In a slow environment, blue-black decks that stack up card advantage likely won more often (estimate).

reasons: 赤緑の重いデッキでは確実に勝負を決める1枚になり、重さのペナルティをモデルが大きく見すぎました。
長期戦になりやすく、重いカードを唱えるまでの時間を確保できたと考えられます。
reasons_en: In heavy red-green decks it reliably closed games, and the model over-penalized its high cost.
Games tended to go long, so players had time to reach the mana for heavy cards (estimate).

reasons: この環境はプレインズウォーカーや大型の伝説が多く、通常の勅令より狙い通りの除去になりやすかったと考えられます。
reasons_en: This environment has many planeswalkers and large legends, so this edict was likely a better-aimed removal spell than usual (estimate).

reasons: 白の平均は下振れ（−1.4pt）でしたが、軽量クリーチャーが多いデッキでは安定して働きました。
この環境は想定より遅く長期戦になりやすかったため、時間をかけて価値を生むカードが強く出たと考えられます。
reasons_en: The white average was below forecast (−1.4pt), but it worked steadily in decks with many cheap creatures.
The environment was slower and longer than expected, so cards that generate value over time likely performed strongly (estimate).

reasons: この環境は伝説やプレインズウォーカーが多く、追放除去の価値が過去セットの類似カードより高くなりました。
長く残って価値を生むプレインズウォーカーや大型カードが強い環境だったため、それらを確実に処理できる除去の価値が上がったと考えられます。
reasons_en: This environment has many legends and planeswalkers, so exile removal was worth more than for similar cards in past sets.
Planeswalkers and large cards that stay and generate value were strong, so removal that reliably answers them became more valuable (estimate).

reasons: 青のジェイス関連カードとの組み合わせで、土地としては高い勝率になりました。
reasons_en: Combined with blue Jace-related cards, it posted a high win rate for a land.

reasons: 青黒の2色土地で、強いカードが多い青黒デッキで多く使われたことが勝率を押し上げたと考えられます。
土地自体の性能よりも、使われるデッキの強さが反映されやすい点をモデルは考慮していません。
reasons_en: A blue-black dual land, likely boosted by being played in the strong blue-black decks (estimate).
The model does not account for how a land's win rate reflects the strength of the decks it is played in.

reasons: 青の占術・諜報テーマが機能したことで、防衛者の制限が外れやすく、想定より攻撃役として働きました。
攻撃寄りのデッキが多くない遅い環境で、序盤を止める役割の価値が高くなったと考えられます。
reasons_en: The blue scry/surveil theme worked, so the defender restriction was often lifted and it contributed more on offense than expected.
In a slow environment without many aggressive decks, a creature that holds off early attacks became more valuable (estimate).

reasons: ジェイスを活かせないデッキでは価値が小さかったと考えられます。
盤面が膠着しやすい環境で、一時的な強化では攻撃を通しきれず、カード1枚分の価値を取り返しにくかったと考えられます。
環境が遅く、小型クリーチャーで攻める白のデッキが押し切る前に止められやすかったと考えられます。
reasons_en: It was likely worth little in decks that cannot take advantage of Jace (estimate).
In a stalled-board environment, a temporary boost often could not push damage through, making it hard to earn back the card (estimate).
The environment was slow, and aggressive white decks with small creatures were likely stopped before they could finish (estimate).

reasons: 赤の攻撃的なデッキ全体が環境で苦戦したことが主因と考えられます。

reasons_en: Aggressive red decks as a whole struggled in this environment, which is thought to be the main reason (estimate).
Many uncommon legends work only under specific conditions or in specific decks, and in real drafts it was likely hard to assemble decks that met them (45 of 53 fell below forecast) (estimate).

ブロッカーが多く盤面が膠着しやすい環境で、攻撃が通らずドローできない場面が多かったと考えられます。
reasons_en: Spending a whole card for a single attack mattered more than expected.
In an environment full of blockers and stalled boards, there were likely many games where it could not connect and so could not draw (estimate).

reasons: モデルは類似カードの勝率に引っ張られましたが、この環境の4マナ帯は強いカードが多く、相対的に弱かったと考えられます。
reasons_en: The model was pulled by similar cards' win rates, but this environment has many strong cards at four mana, so it was relatively weak (estimate).

reasons: 環境が遅く、序盤から攻める赤のデッキが押し切る前に止められやすかったと考えられます。
reasons_en: The environment was slow, and aggressive red decks were likely stopped before they could finish (estimate).

reasons: 相手のマナ総量3以下のパーマネントを追放できますが、この環境の強いカードは4マナ以上が多く、対象が限られました。
赤白は最も攻撃寄りの組み合わせで、遅い環境の影響を最も強く受けたと考えられます（赤白のゴールド4枚はすべて予測を下回りました）。
reasons_en: It can exile permanents with mana value 3 or less, but many of this environment's strong cards cost four or more, limiting its targets.
Red-white is the most aggressive pairing and was likely hit hardest by the slow environment (all four red-white gold cards fell below forecast) (estimate).

reasons: アンコモンの伝説は特定の条件やデッキで働くものが多く、実際のドラフトでは条件を満たすデッキがそろいにくかったと考えられます（53枚中45枚が予測を下回りました）。
使う人が少ないカードは、多くのドラフターが後回しにしたカードです。他に選択肢がなかった弱めのデッキに入りやすく、勝率が低めに出たと考えられます。
reasons_en: Many uncommon legends work only under specific conditions or in specific decks, and in real drafts it was likely hard to assemble decks that met them (45 of 53 fell below forecast) (estimate).
Cards with few samples were passed over by many drafters. They tend to end up in weaker decks with no better options, which likely lowered the win rate (estimate).

reasons: マナ加速の能力を使っても唱えるまで時間がかかり、間に合わない試合が多かったと考えられます。
引いた試合の勝率（GIH WR）は、唱えられない手札の重さも含めて下がりやすく、モデルは「唱えられれば勝つ」強さを過大評価しました。
reasons_en: Even with its mana ability, it takes a long time to cast, and many games likely ended before it came online (estimate).
GIH WR also falls for the weight of a hand you cannot cast, and the model overrated the strength of "wins if it resolves".
